title: AttemptStart

AttemptStart.description: reeval to the runner: run this eval's body for this attempt. Nothing has started yet: the sandbox and the agent session start on the body's first call that needs them, so its own code runs first. The runner sends its calls, then `done`.

attempt.description: `c.attempt`: which cell of the matrix this attempt is, and its run number.

body.description: The eval's `body`, as its declaration named it.

file.description: The eval file, relative to the project.

Cell.description: One cell of an eval: a harness, an environment (`-` when none is set) and that environment's image (`sandbox` id: tag, dockerfile and install). With `compare`, the control is `baseline` (or the cascaded environment, or an empty `baseline`) and each variant is that environment on its own, including its sandbox.

environment.description: The environment's own name, also on a variant cell (`with-house-greeting`, with no prefix).

variant.description: The variant's name, for variant cells.
